title: Levels & Limits: ともなると, に至っては, に至るまで, てまで, にして, までだ, くらいなら
description: Once you reach (that level), as for (the worst case), even down to, go so far as to, only at, I'll simply …, and rather than.

points.title: 〜ともなると / ともなれば: once it comes to
points.summary: Noun / dictionary form + ともなると = at that (higher) level, naturally ….
points.body: - 大学生**ともなれば**、自分のことは自分でするべきだ.
examples: {社長|しゃちょう}ともなると、{忙|いそが}しさが{違|ちが}う。
Once you're the president, you're on a different level of busy.

points.title: 〜に至っては: as for (the most extreme)
points.summary: Noun + に至っては = and the most extreme case of all is A.
points.body: - 家族は皆反対した。父**に至っては**、口もきいてくれない.
examples: {成績|せいせき}が{悪|わる}い。{数学|すうがく}に{至|いた}っては{零点|れいてん}だ。
My grades are bad — in maths I even got zero.

points.title: 〜に至るまで: even down to
points.summary: A から B に至るまで = everything from A right down to B.
points.body: - 服から靴**に至るまで**、すべてブランド品だ.
examples: {子供|こども}から{大人|おとな}に{至|いた}るまで、みんなこの{歌|うた}を{知|し}っている。
Everyone from children to adults knows this song.

points.title: 〜てまで: go so far as to
points.summary: て-form + まで = even going as far as A (usually criticised).
points.body: - 借金をして**まで**車を買う必要はない.
examples: {友達|ともだち}にうそをついてまで{行|い}きたくない。
I don't want to go if it means lying to my friends.

points.title: 〜にして: at (the point of); only
points.summary: Noun + にして = at that age / level, (only then / even). Fixed: この親にしてこの子あり.
points.body: - 四十歳**にして**初めて結婚した.
examples: この{親|おや}にしてこの{子|こ}あり。

points.title: 〜までだ / までのことだ: I'll simply …; only
points.summary: Dictionary form + までだ = if that fails, I'll just do A. た-form + までだ = I only did A (no other reason).
points.body:
- 断られたら、別の店を探す**までだ**.
- 聞かれたから答えた**までです**.
examples: {聞|き}かれたから{答|こた}えたまでです。
I only answered because I was asked.

points.title: 〜くらいなら: rather than (I'd rather)
points.summary: Dictionary form + くらいなら, B (ほうがましだ) = rather than do A, B is better.
points.body: - あんな人に頼む**くらいなら**、自分でやったほうがましだ.
examples: {途中|とちゅう}でやめるくらいなら、{最初|さいしょ}から{始|はじ}めないほうがいい。
If you're going to quit halfway, better not to start at all.

questions.prompt: {大学生|だいがくせい}（　）、{自分|じぶん}のことは{自分|じぶん}でするべきだ。
questions.explanation: Once it comes to: **ともなれば**.
notes: ともなく = 'without really meaning to'.
とばかりに = 'as if to say'.
ときたら = 'when it comes to (complaint)' — doesn't lead into 'should'.
questions.translation: Once you're a university student, you should look after yourself.

questions.prompt: What does 「{社長|しゃちょう}ともなると、{忙|いそが}しさが{違|ちが}う。」 mean?
options: Even without a president, it's busy.
The president is busy, but not very.
Once you're the president, you're on a different level of busy.

questions.prompt: {家族|かぞく}は{皆|みな}{反対|はんたい}した。{父|ちち}（　）、{口|くち}もきいてくれない。
questions.explanation: As for (the extreme case): **に至っては**.
notes: に至って = 'when it reached the point of'.
questions.translation: My whole family opposed it. My father won't even speak to me.

questions.prompt: {成績|せいせき}が{悪|わる}い。{数学|すうがく}（　）{零点|れいてん}だ。
notes: に際して = 'on the occasion of'.
questions.translation: My grades are bad — in maths I even got zero.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{服|ふく}から{靴|くつ}（　）、すべてブランド{品|ひん}だ。
notes: に至っては singles out an extreme case.
に際して = 'on the occasion of'.
にあたって = 'on the occasion of'.
questions.translation: Everything he wears, from clothes right down to shoes, is designer.

questions.prompt: What does 「{子供|こども}から{大人|おとな}に{至|いた}るまで、みんなこの{歌|うた}を{知|し}っている。」 mean?
options: Children grow into adults with this song.
Children know it until they're adults.
Everyone from children to adults knows this song.
questions.explanation: に至るまで = **all the way to**.

questions.prompt: {借金|しゃっきん}をして（　）{車|くるま}を{買|か}う{必要|ひつよう}はない。
questions.explanation: Go so far as to: **てまで**.
notes: 借金をしてだけ isn't grammatical.
借金をしてばかり = 'always borrowing'.
くらいなら follows the dictionary form (借金するくらいなら), not the て-form.
questions.translation: There's no need to go into debt just to buy a car.

questions.prompt: What does 「{友達|ともだち}にうそをついてまで{行|い}きたくない。」 mean?
options: I don't want to lie until I go.
I lied to my friends until I went.
My friends lied so I wouldn't go.
I don't want to go if it means lying to my friends.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{四十歳|よんじゅっさい}（　）{初|はじ}めて{結婚|けっこん}した。
questions.translation: He married for the first time at forty.

questions.prompt: What does 「この{親|おや}にしてこの{子|こ}あり。」 mean?
{断|ことわ}られたら、{別|べつ}の{店|みせ}を{探|さが}す（　）。
questions.translation: If they turn me down, I'll just find another shop.

questions.prompt: What does 「{聞|き}かれたから{答|こた}えたまでです。」 mean?
options: I didn't answer even though I was asked.
I only answered because I was asked.

questions.prompt: あんな{人|ひと}に{頼|たの}む（　）、{自分|じぶん}でやったほうがましだ。
notes: くらいに = 'to the degree that'.
くらいだ = 'to the extent that'.
questions.translation: I'd rather do it myself than ask someone like that.

questions.prompt: What does 「{途中|とちゅう}でやめるくらいなら、{最初|さいしょ}から{始|はじ}めないほうがいい。」 mean?
options: Start from the beginning if you quit.
If you're going to quit halfway, better not to start at all.
